# Release Gate Checklist: Office Addon (DOCX and XLSX)

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before the Office addon is released. Formal gate: all four focus areas (formulas and CSV, file reading and writing, default-on and migration, security and compatibility).
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist tests the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation. It is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command from `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md` and `tasks.md`.

## Formulas and CSV (FR-030, SC-010, SC-011)

- [ ] CHK001 Are the time and size limits for calculating formulas stated as numbers in the requirements, rather than left to the engine trial? [Gap, Spec §FR-030, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the single text form for dates, booleans, blanks and errors in the CSV output written out in the spec, instead of being called "one documented text form"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "unsupported function" decidable: is there a list of functions that must calculate, or of functions known not to? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for circular references, volatile functions (such as NOW and RAND) and links to other files in a calculated read? [Coverage, Gap, Research §R10]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the escaping of commas, quotes and line breaks inside a CSV cell specified? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified whether the agent is told when a calculated result differs from the value saved in the file? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §3d, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK007 Can the 100% target of SC-011 be measured on the fixture set without depending on one trial figure ("18 of 18" on a single workbook)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the acceptance scenarios cover a formula cell in a legacy `.xls` file, which is never calculated? [Coverage, Spec §3f, §FR-030]

## File reading and writing (FR-002 to FR-011, FR-027, FR-028)

- [ ] CHK009 Are the output limits (characters, sheets, rows, columns) given as numbers in the spec, not as "about 200 KB" and "capped"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the behaviour defined when one cell or one paragraph alone exceeds the output limit? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements stated for merged cells, hidden sheets and hidden rows on read? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the Markdown constructs the writer supports, and those it degrades to text, listed so "headings, lists, tables, links" is bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the filename rule (missing or wrong extension, unsafe characters, non-ASCII names) defined, rather than "normalised or refused"? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it stated what a round trip must preserve and what it may lose (header bold, column widths, list depth)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §US2-5]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "readable column widths" quantified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the sheet rules for the write tool (name length, forbidden characters, duplicate names, number of sheets) stated as requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the accepted date and time inputs for writes specified (forms, time zone, 1900 versus 1904 system)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it defined whether control characters in written text are removed, refused or kept, given a Word file must stay valid? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the behaviour for password-protected or encrypted files confirmed as acceptable beyond "not a valid Office file"? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the effect of two people uploading the same filename in a shared channel documented as accepted or out of scope? [Gap, Research §deferred, Spec §FR-027]

## Default-on and migration (US3, US4, FR-015 to FR-021, FR-029)

- [ ] CHK021 Are failure and partial completion of the one-time backfill specified (some agents seeded, then the process stops)? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the persisted marker named the same everywhere (`office.default_seeded` in the data model and plan, `migration.office_default_seeded` in the tracker entry)? [Conflict, Data-model §State, issue-82-entry.md]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for an agent that is created or deleted while the backfill runs? [Gap, Concurrency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "exactly once" measurable for an agent restored or imported after the marker was set? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the recorded actor defined for every ownership case (owner present, no owner, owner account deleted)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the outcome defined when an MCP server or another addon already uses the name or category `office`? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it stated what happens to a turn in progress when the addon is turned off during it? [Exception, Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified whether files the addon wrote stay readable and sendable after the addon is turned off or removed? [Gap, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the downgrade path defined for an older vizier that finds an `office` integration it does not know? [Recovery, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Do the spec, plan and data model agree on the five tool names, the category and the reserved-name rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary]

## Security and compatibility (FR-008, FR-012, FR-028, SC-004, SC-007)

- [ ] CHK031 Does the formula-injection rule cover text read back through the CSV tool as well as text written to a workbook? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the risk of oversized or decompression-bomb input accepted in writing, given the owner's decision to set no input limits? [Assumption, Research §R7, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements stated for macros, embedded objects and external links present in input files? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the breaking change to the generic reader specified with who is affected and the migration path for skills that call it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the owner's decision to drop Word and Excel from the generic reader recorded where reviewers can find it, not only in the spec's clarifications? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the conflict with issue #100 ("do not delete the DOCX and XLSX arms in phase 1") reconciled in the requirements? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, Issue #100]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the Office and LibreOffice versions behind "no repair prompts" named? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the portability requirement for static musl builds consistent with the known `ort-sys` blocker recorded for T050? [Conflict, Plan §Constitution IV, Tasks §T050]

## Traceability and document consistency

- [ ] CHK039 Is the requirement ID scheme complete and ordered (FR-026 is absent, FR-030 follows FR-029 out of place, two Edge Case bullets are merged into one line)? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK040 Do the plan and the spec agree on how fixtures are provided (plan: checked-in files read with `include_bytes!`; FR-022: fixed sample files)? [Conflict, Plan §Project Structure, Spec §FR-022]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add findings inline under the item; link the spec section changed to resolve it.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference. Items marked `[Conflict]` or `[Gap]` are the ones most likely to need a spec change before release.
